CREATE FUNCTION dtxwiki_guard_media_evidence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'media evidence is immutable'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_media_write_intent WHERE workspace_id = OLD.workspace_id AND state = 'deleting') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'media evidence delete requires barrier'; END IF; RETURN OLD; END; $function$

CREATE FUNCTION dtxwiki_reject_graph_observation_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace WHERE id = OLD.workspace_id) THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RAISE EXCEPTION 'graph_observation is append-only'; END; $function$
CREATE TRIGGER graph_observation_no_mutation BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON graph_observation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION dtxwiki_reject_graph_observation_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_media_receipt_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON media_deletion_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION dtxwiki_guard_media_evidence()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_blob_inspection_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON stored_blob_inspection FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION dtxwiki_guard_media_evidence()
